description: Test suite for core helper functions within the litellm project, including tests for metadata extraction, safe division, deep copying, and attribute preservation.

classes.name: ModelResponseStream
classes.description: A mock-up of a model response object used in tests, representing a text completion response with certain attributes.

methods.name: test_get_litellm_metadata_from_kwargs()
methods.description: Tests the extraction of litellm_metadata from nested kwargs.

methods.name: test_add_missing_spend_metadata_to_litellm_metadata()
methods.description: Verifies that missing metadata keys are added appropriately.

methods.name: test_preserve_upstream_non_openai_attributes()
methods.description: Ensures that non-openai attributes on model response objects are preserved during some processing.

methods.name: test_safe_divide_basic()
methods.description: Tests basic division scenarios, including division by zero and float handling.

methods.name: test_safe_divide_edge_cases()
methods.description: Checks behavior of safe_divide with zero numerator, negatives, and floats.

methods.name: test_safe_divide_weight_scenario()
methods.description: Simulates weight normalization, tests division including division by zero for total weight.

methods.name: test_safe_deep_copy_with_non_pickleables_and_span()
methods.description: Validates safe_deep_copy's handling of various object types, non-picklable objects, and internal redacting.
